event_records.description: The team is at base camp. The expedition leader has asked the team to meet tomorrow to decide on a summit-day rope order.

expedition_leader.name: Expedition leader
expedition_leader.persona_brief:
You are Expedition leader.
The leader wants the team to decide on a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting. They have asked the team to discuss and agree on the order.

resolution.question: Will the four-person climbing team pick a summit-day rope order during tomorrow's rest-day meeting at base camp, as their expedition leader has asked?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that during the rest-day meeting (before the hard cutoff), the team actually picks a summit-day rope order (i.e., they agree on a specific order and that decision is recorded or announced). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
